settings.statement_text: Could there be something hidden in our foods that's making us sick beyond what labels or trends tell us?

settings.description: Clean Food Solutions was established with a clear purpose: to identify and promote high-quality foods that are free from pesticides, mycotoxins, and harmful food additives. In a food system increasingly burdened by hidden contaminants, the organization was founded to fill a critical gap—providing consumers with access to cleaner food alternatives and trustworthy information. Its creation stems from a commitment to advancing public health, particularly for children, by focusing on the often-overlooked presence of mycotoxins and their potential impact on long-term wellness.

Beyond offering clean food guidance and recipes, Clean Food Solutions dedicates research funding to studying foodborne mycotoxins, aiming to understand their prevalence and health effects, particularly in vulnerable pediatric populations. Through education, advocacy, and evidence-based resources, the organization empowers individuals to make informed choices.
The mission is simple yet powerful: To help improve human health one bite at a time.

settings.title: Questioning the Status Quo
settings.description: While completing her graduate work, Susan begins noticing alarming gaps in public knowledge about food contaminants, especially in children's diets.

settings.title: First Encounter with Mycotoxins
settings.description: Through early literature reviews, Susan identifies Deoxynivalenol (DON) as a common yet underreported contaminant in grains. This sparks her first deep-dive into the science.

settings.title: Linking Toxins to Inflammation
settings.description: Her analysis of DON and similar mycotoxins reveals strong associations with gut inflammation, immune disruption, and developmental issues in children.

settings.title: Uncovering Systemic Gaps
settings.description: Susan's findings point to major blind spots in food labeling and regulation, particularly concerning exposure levels in "safe" products like bread and milk.

settings.title: Publication and Peer Review
settings.description: Susan's research gains traction in academic circles, leading to peer-reviewed publications and collaborations with food science experts.

settings.title: Building the Solution
settings.description: Frustrated by inaction, Susan founds Clean Food Solutions — bridging research, consumer education, and vetted product partnerships.

settings.title: Expanding the Movement
settings.description: From public speaking to brand advocacy, Susan works to make science accessible and empower families with tools like her book The Fungus Among Us to avoid harmful exposures.

settings.statement_text: Today, Susan’s mission goes beyond research papers. She’s working to make mycotoxin awareness as common as gluten-free, helping families protect what matters most through clear education, better food choices, and new science-backed products
